porcelana.purpose: The one floor of the application: page background, PWA theme colour, scrollbar track. Warm, never blue-grey.

modulo.purpose: Pure white — the only surface that rests on the floor, plus popovers and the sign-in card.

tinta.purpose: Near-black with a trace of violet: the writing ink of the product and the fill of every pill that acts — primary button, current nav item, brand tile.

tinta-2.purpose: Supporting prose — page subtitles, module notes, text buttons at rest. Tinted from the floor rather than a pure grey; 5.2:1 on porcelain.

tinta-3.purpose: Metadata and placeholders only — times, counts, "e mais 9…", disabled controls. 4.7:1 on porcelain, 5.4:1 on a module.

linha.purpose: The single hairline in the system: between consecutive rows inside a module, above a totals row, along the top of the mobile thumb bar.

perigo.purpose: Destructive text buttons, invalid field rings, the marker word of a warning strip, and the 7% wash behind an inline confirmation. Never a fill.

iris.purpose: The hue of the week: day modules, the "hoje" badge, the schedule column on Início.

folha.purpose: The hue of the menu and dinners: the dinner module, the seven-day strip, the dish tiles.

mel.purpose: The hue of the shopping list: the list module, the set chips, the filled checks in the aisle, and the text selection highlight.

terracota.purpose: The hue of the book of dishes and its pantry.

azulejo-verde.purpose: The hue of Finanças — present and designed while the area is still "em breve".

pai.purpose: One household member's pen: the dot beside their line and the tint of their author tag. 6.6:1 on a white module.

mae.purpose: One household member's pen. 6.0:1 on a white module.

filha.purpose: One household member's pen. 5.9:1 on a white module.

groselha.purpose: Health and anything that reads as care; the heartbeat icon carries it.

canela.purpose: Eating out — the restaurant envelope and its chip.

faianca.purpose: Clothes, and the first hue offered to a newly created envelope.

pinho.purpose: The second hue offered to a new income line.

pedra.purpose: The catch-all: Outros, Sem categoria, and transfers between the household own accounts — deliberately the quietest colour on the page.

display.purpose: The greeting, the page title, and the single hero value inside a bento module — tonight's dinner. Drops to 1.75rem below 768px; clamps to three lines.

title.purpose: The sign-in card heading and the running totals at the foot of the list. Drops to 1.375rem below 768px.

strong.purpose: The first thing read in a row or a header — house name, day name, chosen dish, household code.

body.purpose: Everything else, at 500 weight; row names take 700. Prose is held to about 46ch.

label.purpose: Field names, counts, metadata, chips, text buttons, the day badge. Sentence case at 700–800.

micro.purpose: The constrained fifth rung (11px): thumb-bar labels across a 390px phone, the "hoje" badge, the calendar feed address. Never body, never a compared value.

fonts.name: Manrope
fonts.value: variable 200–800, self-hosted woff2 (latin + latin-ext subsets), font-display: swap
fonts.purpose: The entire voice of the system. One family; emphasis is a weight jump, never a second face.

derivation.name: --cor-tile
derivation.purpose: The icon tile and the fill of an opened dinner pastille.

derivation.name: --cor-chip
derivation.purpose: Chip background, today's soft wash, hover on a dinner pastille.

derivation.name: --cor-premido
derivation.purpose: The pressed / hovered state of a chip.

derivation.name: --cor-texto
derivation.purpose: The drawing inside a tile, and hue-tinted labels on white.

derivation.name: chip label
derivation.purpose: Deeper than --cor-texto on purpose: the lighter mix measured 3.7:1 on its own chip.

shadows.name: sombra-modulo
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation of every module, the week navigation pill group, and an opened dinner pastille.

shadows.name: sombra-alta
shadows.purpose: Hover on a touchable module, today's day module, floating popovers, and the sign-in card.

shadows.name: aro-foco
shadows.purpose: The 2px ink ring drawn inside a focused field. An inset stroke, not elevation.

shadows.name: aro-visto
shadows.purpose: The unchecked check circle; goes to full hue on hover and to a full fill when checked.

motion.name: mola
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system. Every transition and animation uses it.

motion.name: toque
motion.purpose: Washes and colour changes on small controls — nav items, chips, text buttons, menu items.

motion.name: elevacao
motion.purpose: A touchable module lifting 2px on hover and pressing to 0.985 on active.

motion.name: chegar
motion.purpose: A page arriving; popovers reuse it at 200ms.

motion.name: vistopop
motion.purpose: The single flourish in the product, spent on the moment a shopping item is completed.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → all transitions and animations collapse to 0.01ms; the page entrance is removed entirely

motion.name: golpe
motion.purpose: The stretch of meter a new movement added, lit at 40% hue and settling. The only mark on screen that says how much.

motion.name: acusar
motion.purpose: An envelope tile flashing its full category hue with a white icon to acknowledge what it just received.

motion.name: contagem
motion.purpose: A figure walking to its new value. Never on mount; interrupts from wherever the eye left it.

motion.name: subir
motion.purpose: The year strip drawing itself along the axis of time, all categories at the same step.

motion.name: registado
motion.purpose: A ring of finance-teal light around the register module — the only signal that returns to a thumb when the envelope it fed is off-screen.

breakpoints.name: medida
breakpoints.value: max-width: 75rem (1200px) — the shared measure of top bar, page and warning strips

breakpoints.name: coluna-dia
breakpoints.value: columns: 19rem — the packing width of the week's day modules

components.name: Módulo (touchable)
components.description: The defining surface: a white module resting on the porcelain floor, showing one area's real data. The whole surface is the button.
components.css: .ds-modulo { --cor-tile: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 14%, #fff); --cor-texto: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 78%, #1c1b20); appearance: none; border: 0; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; width: 340px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; background: #fff; color: #1c1b20; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.22), 0 1px 2px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.05); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-modulo:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px -20px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.30), 0 2px 4px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.06); } .ds-modulo:active { transform: scale(0.985); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.22), 0 1px 2px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.05); } .ds-modulo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b20; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-modulo-cabeca { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; } .ds-tile { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--cor-tile); color: var(--cor-texto); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; } .ds-modulo-titulo { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-modulo-meta { margin-inline-start: auto; color: #6f6a5c; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-modulo-destaque { font-size: 2.125rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-modulo-nota { color: #696456; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Pílula (primary button)
components.description: The one button that commits. Ink fill, white label, full pill. Never more than one on a screen.
components.css: .ds-pilula { appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1c1b20; color: #fff; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 800; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pilula:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 86%, #fff); } .ds-pilula:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pilula:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b20; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pilula:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; transform: none; }

components.name: Botão de texto
components.description: The quiet secondary action, including the destructive one. Label-size type, no background, negative margins so the label stays optically aligned.
components.css: .ds-botao-texto { appearance: none; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 6px; margin: -4px -6px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #696456; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-botao-texto:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 6%, transparent); color: #1c1b20; } .ds-botao-texto:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b20; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-botao-texto:disabled { color: #6f6a5c; background: none; cursor: default; } .ds-botao-texto--perigo { color: #b4432c; } .ds-botao-texto--perigo:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #b4432c 8%, transparent); color: #b4432c; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: An action chip in an area's hue — a set of shopping items to pour into the list. Background, hover and label all derive from one --cor.
components.css: .ds-chip { appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 8%, #fff); color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 42%, #1c1b20); font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.01em; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 20%, #fff); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b20; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-conta { font-weight: 700; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 25%, #1c1b20); }

components.name: Campo (text field)
components.description: Borderless field: an ink wash on white that deepens on hover and turns white with a 2px inset ink ring on focus. Nothing moves and nothing glows.
components.css: .ds-campo { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 280px; max-width: 100%; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-campo-nome { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #696456; } .ds-campo-escrita { appearance: none; border: 0; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 5%, #fff); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c1b20; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-campo-escrita::placeholder { color: #6f6a5c; font-weight: 500; } .ds-campo-escrita:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 7%, #fff); } .ds-campo-escrita:focus { outline: none; background: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #1c1b20; } .ds-campo-escrita[aria-invalid="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #b4432c; }

components.name: Navegação (pills)
components.description: Five destinations, always all five. Desktop: pills in the top bar, current page a solid ink pill. Mobile: the same pills stack icon over label in a blurred bottom thumb bar.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { appearance: none; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; color: #696456; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 6%, transparent); color: #1c1b20; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b20; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: #1c1b20; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item:disabled { color: #6f6a5c; background: none; cursor: default; }

components.name: Visto (check)
components.description: The check a shopping item gets: an aro in the module's hue when undone, a full fill with a drawn tick when done, plus a 320ms overshoot on completion. The hit area extends 8px past the drawing.
components.css: .ds-visto { appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 38%, #fff); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; flex: none; position: relative; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-visto::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -8px; } .ds-visto:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--cor); } .ds-visto:active { transform: scale(0.9); } .ds-visto:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b20; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-visto[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--cor); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--cor); } .ds-visto svg { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.5); transition: opacity 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-visto[aria-checked="true"] svg { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

components.name: Fila (list row)
components.description: A row inside a module: check, name over metadata, right-aligned tabular numbers, overflow button. A hairline between rows and nothing else — no box, no radius, no fill.
components.html:
Queijo flamengo fatiadoBacalhau à Brás300 g
Ovos M12 un
components.css: .ds-filas { display: grid; width: 340px; max-width: 100%; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fila { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; min-height: 40px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-fila + .ds-fila { border-top: 1px solid #e7e4da; } .ds-fila-visto { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; flex: none; background: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 38%, #fff); } .ds-fila-visto--feito { background: var(--cor); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--cor); } .ds-fila-corpo { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-fila-nome { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1c1b20; } .ds-fila-meta { color: #6f6a5c; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-fila-numero { margin-inline-start: auto; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; color: #696456; font-size: 0.9375rem; flex: none; } .ds-fila--feita .ds-fila-nome { color: #6f6a5c; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 55%, transparent); } .ds-fila--feita .ds-fila-numero { color: #6f6a5c; }

components.name: Tira (day strip)
components.description: The week's dinners as seven 96px pastilles. Today carries the chip tint; the open day fills with the tile tint and lifts onto the resting module shadow. A mask fades the trailing edge.
components.css: .ds-tira { --cor-tile: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 14%, #fff); --cor-chip: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 8%, #fff); --cor-texto: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 78%, #1c1b20); list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 4px 0 8px; display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-tira::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .ds-tira-celula { appearance: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; flex: none; width: 96px; border-radius: 16px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 4%, #fff); padding: 10px; display: grid; gap: 2px; text-align: start; font-family: inherit; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tira-celula:hover { background: var(--cor-chip); } .ds-tira-celula:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-tira-celula:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1b20; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tira-celula[data-aberta] { background: var(--cor-tile); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -18px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.22), 0 1px 2px rgb(28 27 32 / 0.05); } .ds-tira-celula[data-hoje]:not([data-aberta]) { background: var(--cor-chip); } .ds-tira-dia { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--cor-texto); } .ds-tira-data { color: #6f6a5c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tira-prato { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1c1b20; min-height: 2.6em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-tira-prato--vazio { color: #6f6a5c; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Ícone desenhado
components.description: The in-house icon system: 24×24 viewBox, 1.8 stroke, round caps and joins, rendered at 20px inside a tile tinted from the area's hue. No emoji, no library, no photography.
components.css: .ds-tile { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 16px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 14%, #fff); color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 78%, #1c1b20); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; }

components.name: Envelope
components.description: A category and its month: a row that opens. Closed it is tile, name, amount, meter and a foot line carrying the editable ceiling and the count.
components.html: 3 movimentos
components.css: .ds-env { --cor: #5561b8; display: grid; padding: 10px 0; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1b20; } .ds-env-topo { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 100%; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; color: inherit; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-env-tile { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 14%, #fff); color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 78%, #1c1b20); } .ds-env-corpo { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-env-cabeca { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-env-titulo { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; } .ds-env-seta { color: #6f6a5c; } .ds-env-nome { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; } .ds-env-valor { font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-env-barra { display: block; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 7%, #fff); overflow: hidden; } .ds-env-cheio { display: block; height: 100%; width: 97%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cor); } .ds-env-pe { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; padding-inline-start: 48px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-env-tecto { background: none; border: 0; padding: 4px 6px; margin: -4px -6px; border-radius: 12px; font: inherit; font-weight: 800; color: #696456; cursor: pointer; } .ds-env-tecto:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 6%, transparent); color: #1c1b20; } .ds-env-topo:hover .ds-env-nome { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 78%, #1c1b20); } .ds-env-conta { color: #6f6a5c; font-weight: 600; }

components.css: .ds-pista { display: grid; gap: 12px; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1b20; } .ds-pista-cab { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-pista-tit { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-pista-dia { margin: 0; color: #6f6a5c; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pista-num { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; } .ds-pista-gasto { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pista-de { color: #696456; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pista-barra { position: relative; height: 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 7%, #fff); overflow: hidden; } .ds-pista-corredor { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; inset-inline-start: 76%; width: 16%; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 12%, transparent); border-inline: 1.5px solid color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 30%, transparent); } .ds-pista-gasta { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; width: 96%; border-radius: 999px; background: #2f7e78; } .ds-pista-leitura { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-pista-selo { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #b9862c 14%, #fff); color: color-mix(in oklab, #b9862c 80%, #1c1b20); } .ds-pista-nota { color: #6f6a5c; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-anol { --cor: #5561b8; display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 0; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1b20; max-width: 320px; } .ds-anol-cab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-anol-tile { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 14%, #fff); color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 78%, #1c1b20); } .ds-anol-nome { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; } .ds-anol-total { margin-inline-start: auto; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-anol-meses { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; align-items: end; } .ds-anol-mes { display: grid; gap: 3px; justify-items: center; } .ds-anol-tubo { width: 100%; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1c1b20 5%, #fff); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-anol-tubo i { width: 100%; background: var(--cor); border-radius: 3px; } .ds-anol-ini { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #6f6a5c; } .ds-anol-media { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6f6a5c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The house seen from above. The application is a warm porcelain floor, and resting on it are white modules — one for each area of family life. A module is never a label with an arrow into somewhere else; it is the thing itself, showing its own live data at the size the data deserves. Tonight's dinner is a headline you read from across the kitchen. The list is three real items and a count. Today's schedule is three real lines with real times. A parent should get dinner, the list and the day in about three seconds, and one tap should swell any module into its full page.

The character is calm, warm and modern-consumer: soft porcelain rather than cold grey, generous 24px corners, true offset shadows that put the modules a few millimetres above the floor, one geometric sans in the full range from 200 to 800, and black ink pills for the actions that matter. Colour is not decoration here — it is the address system. Each of the five areas of the house owns a hue (week iris, menu leaf, list honey, book terracotta, finances tile-green), and every tint that area needs is derived from that one hue by a single formula. Nothing in this system is a pastel someone picked by eye.

What it refuses is as fixed as what it does. It refuses the notebook metaphor and every paper simulation that came with it. It refuses the single-list template where five different jobs get the same row. It refuses the card-inside-a-card: once you are inside a module, hierarchy is made of type and space, never of another box. It refuses coloured borders as state — a selected, current or open thing announces itself with light and lift, not with a ring. And it refuses borrowed pictures: every icon is drawn in this repository in a single 1.8 stroke, with no emoji, no icon library and no photography.
keyCharacteristics: Porcelain ground (#f2f0ea) with pure white modules floating on it — one ground, one surface, no third plane.
One hue per area of the house; all four of its working tints derived from that hue by one color-mix formula.
Manrope alone, 200–800, in five size steps — four for reading and one constrained micro rung; the hierarchy is carried by weight and space, not by more sizes.
8px governs every gap, every padding and every radius.
Numbers are tabular and right-aligned, everywhere, without exception.
State is a colour wash plus a raised shadow — never a border colour.
Drawn-in-house icons: 24×24 box, 1.8 stroke, round caps and joins.
A hue is never text at full strength: text on a category colour is derived, not raw.
A module decides its own columns from its own width, not from the width of the screen.
Nothing judges without a real number behind it: no verdict from a partial estimate.

rules.name: The One Formula Rule
rules.body: Any element carrying .com-cor declares a single --cor and receives its whole family by derivation: tile at 14% over white, chip at 8% over white, pressed at 20% over white, text at 78% over ink — all mixed in OKLab. No tint in this system is hand-picked. Change the area's hue and every surface, chip, wash and label in that area moves with it. A new pastel typed in by hand is a bug, not a variant.

rules.name: The Derived Tint Rule
rules.body: A hue is a surface colour, never a text colour. Text that must carry a category identity takes color-mix(in oklab, var(--cor) 78%, var(--tinta)) — the same 78% the .com-cor formula already mixes. Measured on white, raw honey (#b9862c) reaches 3.2:1 and fails; the derived tint reaches 4.7:1 and passes.

rules.name: The Legible Pen Rule
rules.body: Every member ink and every chip label carries a measured contrast ratio, not an eyeballed one. The pens were deepened until each cleared 4.5:1 at body size on a white module, and the chip label takes more ink than --cor-texto does (42% hue into ink, not 78%) because the lighter mix sat at 3.7:1 on its own chip. If a colour cannot be read at 15px, it does not ship at 15px.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one floor and one surface. Porcelain is the only background of the application; white is the only thing that rests on it. There is no third plane, no tinted section band, no grey card behind a group of cards.

rules.name: The Five Steps Rule
rules.body: There are five type sizes and nothing between them — 11, 12, 15, 18, 24, plus 34 for display. Four of them are for reading. The fifth, 11px, is a constrained rung and needs a reason a designer would accept: five thumb-bar labels that must fit across a 390px phone, the "hoje" badge, a subscription URL that has to be read once and copied. If a new element seems to need a size that is not on this list, the answer is a weight change or a space change, not a new size.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: One family carries the entire product. Emphasis is weight (500 → 700 → 800), never italic, never a second face, never letter-spaced small caps standing in for a heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Every number the household reads or compares is font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and right-aligned in its column: quantities, prices, times, totals, dates, the household code. A quantity that shifts sideways as it is typed is a quantity the eye has to re-find.

rules.name: The Eight Rule
rules.body: 8px rules every gap, every padding and every radius. A value that is not a multiple of 8 needs a reason written next to it; the only standing exceptions are hairlines, the 2px focus and check rings, and the 6–8px author dot.

rules.name: The Unclipped Quantity Rule
rules.body: A truncated quantity is a wrong purchase. The quantity column in the shopping list measures itself in ch against the longest value present — with tabular numerals 1ch is one digit — clamped between 48px and 11rem, so it opens for "500 g + 2 un" and closes again when the list is all "2 un". It is the item name, never the number, that gives up the width.

rules.name: The Light-and-Lift Rule
rules.body: State is light and elevation, never a border colour. Today's day module raises to the high shadow and takes a soft gradient wash of its own hue from the top edge down to white at 42% — plus a small filled "hoje" pill to say the rest in words. An earlier version of this ringed the module in its hue; the ring was removed because a coloured outline reads as an error state and as a card-inside-a-card at the same time. Selection, currency and openness are all expressed the same way: more colour, more lift.

rules.name: The True Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset and blurred, never a symmetric glow. A box-shadow with a zero y-offset spreading evenly in all directions is a halo, and this world does not have haloes. The only zero-offset shadows in the system are inset rings — the 2px focus ring on a field and the 2px aro of an unchecked check — which are strokes drawn inside the shape, not elevation.

rules.name: The No Card In A Card Rule
rules.body: A module never contains another surface. Inside it, hierarchy is made of type, weight, space and — sparingly — one hairline. A grouped set of rows indents by half a tile (24px) to show it belongs to the row above; it does not get a background, a border or a shadow of its own.

rules.name: The One Gesture Rule
rules.body: A module has exactly one opening gesture, not a dust of little buttons. On Início the entire module is the button and tapping anywhere in it swells the area into its full page. Inside a page, the same rule holds one level down: a dinner pastille opens the day, a book row opens the dish, a row's overflow menu is the single extra affordance and it lives in one place at the end of the row.

rules.name: The No Verdict Without A Number Rule
rules.body: A column of the Balanço judges only when its estimate is real: spending needs at least one ceiling set (committed bills alone are a part of a budget, not a budget), the net needs both sides. Where the estimate is missing the column says what is missing — sem tecto posto — and drops the difference line entirely rather than reporting a difference against zero.

rules.name: The Honest Denominator Rule
rules.body: An average divides by the months a row actually had movement, never by the months of the calendar. A household that starts in August has four months of rent at 847 € and would read 424 — half, wearing the face of a right answer.

rules.name: The Consequence Rule
rules.body: Registering a gasto is not a number changing — the envelope takes the blow, and that visible consequence is the whole reward for having registered. The tile flashes its category hue, the total counts to its new figure, the ceiling line counts with it so the two numbers never contradict each other mid-flight, and the stretch of meter between where the bar was and where it landed lights up and settles. None of it ever fires on mount.

dos: Do set a single --cor on a container and let the formula derive tile (14%), chip (8%), pressed (20%) and text (78%). Adding a new area means adding one hex, not five.
Do keep every gap, padding and radius a multiple of 8px.
Do make numbers tabular and right-aligned — quantities, prices, times, totals, dates, the household code.
Do express state as a colour wash plus a raised shadow, and add a word (a "hoje" pill, a count) when the wash alone could be ambiguous.
Do carry hierarchy inside a module with type, weight and space alone.
Do measure a numeric column against its longest real value in ch when clipping it would change the meaning.
Do draw new icons in src/componentes/Icones.tsx on the 24×24 box at 1.8 stroke with round caps and joins, matching the existing set.
Do give every control its rest, hover, active, focus-visible and disabled states — the focus ring is a 2px ink outline at 2px offset, everywhere.
Do give a module exactly one opening gesture and make the whole surface the target.
Do write empty states as one sentence inside the module.
Do run a hue through the 78% derivation before it becomes text. Raw honey on white is 3.2:1; the derived tint is 4.7:1.
Do let a module decide its own column count from its own width with a container query. The screen width is not the module width.
Do compute a state — burst, reached, over, under — on the thing that has it, so a parent condition never paints its children.
Do say what is missing when a number has no estimate behind it, and show no difference at all rather than a difference against zero.
Do animate a number only when it changes while someone is watching. On mount every figure is already its final value.
Do reduce movement rather than erase it under prefers-reduced-motion: spatial motion goes, colour, opacity and a meter settling at 120ms stay.

Do ask once, in the line, before a destructive bulk action: the button becomes "Apagar 12" beside a "deixar estar" and a plain sentence saying there is no way back. No modal — the task needs a second thought, not a protected screen.
donts: Don't hand-pick a pastel. Any tint not produced by the formula is a defect.
Don't put a card, a bordered box, a tinted panel or a second shadow inside a module.
Don't use a border colour to signal state — no coloured rings on selected, current or open things.
Don't ship a symmetric glow. Shadows are offset and blurred; zero-offset shadows are reserved for the inset focus and check rings.

Don't introduce a second font family, an italic, or a sixth type size. Reach for weight or space instead — and the fifth step (11px) needs a constraint that a designer would accept, not a paragraph that did not fit.
Don't use emoji, an icon library, or photography anywhere in the product.
Don't put a third plane on the screen — porcelain floor, white module, nothing between.
Don't scatter small buttons across a module to make it openable; one gesture, whole surface.
Don't let a quantity, price or dish name that the household typed get clipped by a fixed-width column.
Don't ship a full-screen empty state where a sentence inside the module will do.

Don't put a button inside a button. The ceiling control lives beside the row that opens an envelope, not inside its target — nested buttons are invalid and the inner one stops being reachable by keyboard.
Don't draw a meter with nothing to measure. No budget means no track, not an empty one.
Don't deliver a verdict from a partial estimate. The pace refuses to judge before day 7 and without a budget; every other number on the page owes the household the same discipline.
Don't scroll a wide table sideways and call it responsive. If the first screen of a phone shows no data, the layout is replaced, not adapted.
